theme_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Premium Glassmorphic Ecosystem
theme_archetype.tone: Mentor tone, simplified language, user-friendly for non-finance individuals

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-800
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500

grid_system.rules: Mobile-first responsive grid. Override default stretch with align-items: start where necessary. Grid items must be direct children of the grid container.

glassmorphism.card: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] rounded-3xl
glassmorphism.hero_card: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/50 shadow-lg rounded-3xl overflow-hidden relative

hero_metrics.description: ArthSthithi Score (0-100) + Retirement Age. Top-left placement. Gamified animated SVG ring wrapping the score.

progress_bars.description: 10-Factor Financial Health Analysis. Use customized Shadcn Progress or Framer Motion divs. Gamified look with rounded-full edges. Use Orange to Blue gradient fill.

charts.description: Recharts / Shadcn charts for Income & Expense Breakdown, Asset Allocation (SVG Donut Charts). Use the primary blue and gamification orange palette with clean tooltips. Remove axis lines for a cleaner look.

risk_meter.description: Gauge or colored bar indicator (Green/Yellow/Red) mapping to risk level.

action_cards.description: 3 Highest Impact Actions. Simple glassmorphic cards with bullet points and a 'mentor tone' description.
action_cards.layout: col-span-1 md:col-span-3 lg:col-span-4 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6

motion_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow (shadow-lg) and border color shift. Buttons scale up slightly (scale-105).
motion_interactions.animations: Framer Motion for entrance animations (staggered list items). Animated progress rings filling up on viewport enter (transition: duration 1.5s ease-out).
motion_interactions.micro_interactions: Smooth transitions on all interactive elements (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).

images.description: Smiling professional mentor portrait. Used in the 'Insights' or 'Advice' section to add a human, trustworthy tone to the data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Framer Motion to animate the ArthSthithi Score SVG progress rings and gamified progress bars for the 10-Factor Analysis.

Implement the 'Sleek Glassmorphism' surface strictly on structural cards by combining bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, and border-white/40 over a subtle gradient background (e.g., bg-slate-50 with soft blue/orange blurred blobs).
Do NOT change existing formulas, input logic, or retire badge triggers. Focus entirely on the visual presentation and frontend component architecture.
Use Plus Jakarta Sans for all headings (with tight tracking) and Inter for all body text.
Content should be simplified, using bullet points and a 'mentor tone' to explain the Ideal vs Actual insights for the Financial Opportunity Analyzer and Net Worth Statement.
Build SVG Donut Charts using Recharts for Asset Allocation and Income/Expense Breakdown.
Ensure the layout follows the 'Control Room' grid philosophy (dense but clean, gap-6, utilizing every pixel logically) but wraps it in the approachable, premium glassmorphism aesthetic.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive and key informational elements (e.g., data-testid='arthsthithi-score', data-testid='retirement-age-value').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphic surfaces maintains WCAG AA / APCA standards. Use dark text (#0F172A) on light glassmorphic backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none for all interactive elements.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion animations in prefers-reduced-motion checks.
